scope: Source files read-only. Each edit references its original WebP. Generated PNGs copied verbatim from tool output. No Python painting, fading, or pixel modification. Production padding/conversion and runtime integration delegated to root.

entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent painted 2.5D layer for a Chinese handscroll. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, not a loose style reference. Repair ONLY the abrupt left and right outer ends of this ultrawide palace-room stage. Preserve the existing central peony-and-crane folding wall, all columns, hanging tassels, drapery, railings, incense furniture, stone floor, perspective, scale, detailed gongbi brushwork, muted jade green / cinnabar red / antique gold palette. No people are in this target: do not add any. Extend the canvas a small amount sideways and finish BOTH ends as believable complete silhouettes: complete the terminal railing/column and turn the stone edge into a short irregular stone/plant ending with finely drawn natural contours. No vertical rectangular truncation at either outer edge. Keep the whole current stage visible, all structural tips intact, with a small transparent safety margin around the entire cutout. The composition remains very wide and low; do not build new roofs or tall objects above the current design. Do not add text, seals, extra furniture, new scene subjects, clouds, mist, big soft fades, opaque paper background, checkerboard painting, border, or watermark. Actual RGBA transparent background, retaining crisp artwork and naturally detailed edge contours.
entries.visualReview: Both former vertical terminations repaired as full natural stone/tree/railing ends. Central peony-and-crane palace stage retained. No people/text added. No broad fog or opaque backdrop. RGBA transparency verified; alpha>=16 content bbox [8,79,2168,619].
